retinol peeling: push through or stop?

Some flaking and a quick sting are common in the first weeks. Keep going, with more moisturizer.

Redness that lasts all day, burning when water touches your face, oozing or swelling are signs to cut back or stop. In a 26-week study, 3 of 57 women stopped retinol because of irritation.

Start twice a week, use a pea-sized amount at night, and build up slowly.

Save this for week one of retinol.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Sources:
Kikuchi et al., 2009 (0.075% retinol, 57 women, 26 weeks)
Mambwe et al., Int J Cosmet Sci 2025 (review)
